title.zh: Aave创始人：密切关注MetaMask质押事件，Aave市场未受影响
title.en: Aave创始人：密切关注MetaMask质押事件，Aave市场未受影响

current_state.zh: MetaMask正在调查一起未披露的安全事件，并退出其运营的以太坊质押验证者作为预防措施；Lido确认验证者退出并提示可能罚没，Aave市场此前确认未受影响。
current_state.en: MetaMask is investigating an undisclosed security incident affecting its infrastructure and is exiting its operated Ethereum staking validators as a precaution; Lido confirmed the validator exits and flagged potential penalties, while Aave markets remain unaffected per the founder's earlier statement.

updates.what_changed_zh: Aave创始人Stani表示，其团队正与Lido一同监控MetaMask Staking基础设施安全事件，并确认Aave市场未受影响，所有操作正常运行。
updates.what_changed_en: Aave founder Stani said his team is monitoring the MetaMask Staking infrastructure security incident alongside Lido, confirming that Aave markets are unaffected and all operations are running normally.

updates.title_zh: MetaMask因未披露的安全事件退出以太坊验证者行列
updates.title_en: MetaMask exits Ethereum validators amid undisclosed security incident
updates.what_changed_zh: MetaMask正在调查一起影响其基础设施的安全事件，并作为预防措施退出其运营的以太坊质押验证者；Lido确认验证者退出并提示可能产生罚没；最后一批受影响验证者预计10月7日前退出，提款再进入周期估计最长45天。
updates.what_changed_en: MetaMask is investigating a security incident affecting its infrastructure and is exiting its operated Ethereum staking validators as a precaution; Lido confirmed the validator exits and flagged potential penalties; the last affected validators are expected to exit by Oct. 7, with withdrawal and re-entry cycle estimated up to 45 days.
